body.name: \(\ell_{P,h},r_{P,h},\mathcal C_{P,h},e_h,\bar e_h\)
body.construction: \(\ell_{P,h}(x)=\max\{-M,\max_{(d,z)\in H_h}[g(d,z)-K|z|-L|x-d|]\}\), \(r_{P,h}(x)=\min\{M,\min_{(d,z)\in H_h}[g(d,z)+K|z|+L|x-d|]\}\), \(\mathcal C_{P,h}=\{v\in C(X_0):\operatorname{Lip}(v)\le L,\ \ell_{P,h}\le v\le r_{P,h}\}\), \(e_h=\max\{\|\ell_P-\ell_{P,h}\|_\infty,\|r_{P,h}-r_P\|_\infty\}\), and \(\bar e_h=(K+L)h+Gh^\beta\).
